name: meetingeconomy
description: MeetingEconomy - meeting intelligence, cost analytics, and MOM automation SaaS.

scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @meetingeconomy/api" "npm run dev -w @meetingeconomy/web"
scripts.dev:full: npm run db:generate && concurrently -n api,web,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @meetingeconomy/api" "npm run dev -w @meetingeconomy/web" "npm run worker -w @meetingeconomy/api"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
